verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents manual approve/reject decisions on applicants regardless of status, an applicant profile where reviewers inspect check results such as Liveness, and an AI overview showing status, rejection reasons and next steps. Webhooks notify on verification status changes, which implies manual decisions propagate to the record and to integrators. Missing for 10: explicit routing of borderline cases into a manual review queue, documented display of document images and extracted fields in the review view, explicit confirmation that reviewer decisions are written back to the applicant record, independent or hands-on corroboration.
